title: 第五章
slug: 娇软妹宝随军后禁欲军官沦陷了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

苏清荔抬眸一看。

发现这人是她报名文工团时，坐她隔壁的。

林美香显然也认出了她。

见她沉默不语，还把房间弄的乱糟糟的，当即不客气说，“喂，我问你话呢，你是聋了吗？”

苏清荔懒懒看她一眼，“你又是谁？我为什么要理你？”

林美香被她不咸不淡的语气堵回来，脸色相当难看。

但想到刘红英，她底气十足地说，“站在你面前的是房间主人的女朋友，你说她有没有资格？”

刘红英虽不喜林美香拿她说事，但还是默认了傅谨严女朋友的说法。

闻言，苏清荔有些惊讶。

傅谨严有女朋友了？

她怎么没听傅大山提起过？

等等，要是傅谨严有女朋友，苏云如是不是就不能逼着她跟傅谨严相处了？

想到这里，苏清荔看着两人顺眼许多。

“我是他妹。”

听到这话，林美香心里泛起嘀咕。

“我怎么不知道傅谨严说过他有个这么漂亮的妹妹？”

说罢，她又将目光看向刘红英。

刘红英摇了摇头。

显然心里存着相同的困惑。

正当两人对此有些不知所措时，恰好王兵已经忙完手中的事，正打算去接苏清荔时，却听门卫说她去傅谨严住处了就忙赶了过来。

“呦，红英姐，你们也在呢。”

刘红英父亲是军区长官，又经常见她跟傅谨严见面，所以王兵对她也很熟悉。

“我来帮谨严收拾房间，”刘红英朝他笑笑，又道，“王兵，你到这里有什么事吗？”

王兵这才想起此行目的。

“啊，营长妹妹要来，就让我收拾出一间家属院给她住，这不刚忙完，欸，她人呢？”

王兵四周扫了一眼。

刘红英没想到苏清荔说的都是真的，表情有些沉默。

不由懊恼自己刚刚太冲动了。

刚要对苏清荔道歉，就听王兵满心疑惑地说，“说是今天过来啊，难道是等不及先离开了？”

刘红英忍不住问，“她不就在这呢？”

见她指着苏清荔，王兵睁大了眼睛。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Su Qingli raised her eyes and took a look.

She found out that this person was the one who sat next to her when she signed up for the art troupe.

Lin Meixiang obviously recognized her.

Seeing that she was silent and making a mess in the room, he immediately said rudely, "Hey, I want to ask you something, are you deaf?"

Su Qingli glanced at her lazily, "Who are you? Why should I care about you?"

Lin Meixiang was turned back by her salty tone, and her expression was quite ugly.

But thinking of Liu Hongying, she said confidently, "The person standing in front of you is the girlfriend of the room owner. Do you think she is qualified?"

Although Liu Hongying didn't like Lin Meixiang's accusations against her, she still acquiesced to Fu Jinyan's girlfriend's statement.

Hearing this, Su Qingli was a little surprised.

Fu Jingyan has a girlfriend?

Why hasn't she heard Fu Dashan mention it?

Wait, if Fu Jinyan had a girlfriend, wouldn't Su Yunru be able to force her to get along with Fu Jinyan?

Thinking of this, Su Qingli looked at the two of them much more pleasingly.

"I'm his sister."

Hearing this, Lin Meixiang murmured in her heart.

"Why didn't I know that Fu Jinyan said that he had such a beautiful sister?"

After saying that, she looked at Liu Hongying again.

Liu Hongying shook her head.

Apparently they have the same confusion in their hearts.

Just when the two of them were a little overwhelmed by this, Wang Bing happened to have finished what he was doing and was about to pick up Su Qingli when he heard the guard say that she had gone to Fu Jinyan's residence and hurried over.

"Hey, Sister Hongying, you are here too."

Liu Hongying's father was a military commander, and he often saw her meeting Fu Jinyan, so Wang Bing was also familiar with her.

"I'm here to help Jinyan clean up the room," Liu Hongying smiled at him and said, "Wang Bing, what do you want here?"

Only then did Wang Bing remember the purpose of his trip.

"Ah, the battalion commander's sister is coming, so she asked me to clean up a family home for her to live in. I've just finished my work. Hey, where is she?"

Wang Bing glanced around.

Liu Hongying didn't expect that what Su Qingli said was true, and her expression was a little silent.

I couldn't help but feel annoyed that I had been too impulsive just now.

Just as he was about to apologize to Su Qingli, Wang Bing said with confusion, "You said you were coming today. Could it be that you couldn't wait and left first?"

Liu Hongying couldn't help but ask, "Isn't she right here?"

Seeing her pointing at Su Qingli, Wang Bing opened his eyes wide.
